newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: SAfrica noon industrials edge up, Daewoo off.
newsitem.headline: SAfrica noon industrials edge up, Daewoo off.

text.p: 1032 GMT - South African noon industrial shares steady to slightly firmer in directionless trade, but golds continue to take a knock from a listless bullion price. Dealers say market looking for direction after recent barrage of economic data, which gives conflicting signals on possible interest rate cut. Sentiment, however, still fairly upbeat.

* Dealers say Reserve Bank Governor Chris Stals' comments earlier that a rate reduction could be in the offing by the end of the year reignites some hopes for an early cut which dimmed after smaller-than-expected slowdown in country's credit growth. * Dealers say turnover moderate and so far worth around 256 million rand.

* Daewoo Electronics SA Ltd sheds 20 cents to 280 cents on profit-taking after the stock's recent climb on good results prospects. Electronics to healthcare company, Jasco, also loses 15 cents to 310 cents on profit-taking. Jasco earlier this week said bank Capital Alliance boiught a stake in it. Also sold scientific unit to medical group Macmed which down 10 cents to 430 cents.
* Industrials add 5.3 points to 9,110.6, golds lose 10.7 points to 976.1, and the all-shares sheds 15.5 points to 7,458.3.
